title: Restic: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116587)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability affects the restic package through its use of Go JOSE, which implements Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards. The flaw impacts versions prior to 0.18.1-r13 and can cause denial of service (availability impact) without compromising confidentiality or integrity. A patch is available in version 0.18.1-r13.
